records.finding: Dense prostate nuclei have broad, partially confluent virtual DAPI; the boundary contrast 0.049 is just below the frozen gate, so the visual preview does not requalify it.
Kidney field is blood-rich; virtual DAPI has scattered peaks and diffuse surrounding signal, with incomplete correspondence to independent outlines (AUC 0.654).
Dense prostate region has blurred virtual-DAPI peaks bridging separately outlined nuclei (AUC 0.711, contrast 0.040).
Dense prostate lymphoid-looking field shows almost confluent virtual DAPI across many separate H&E nuclei, with contrast 0.019.
Dense prostate nuclei remain distinct in scanner RGB while virtual DAPI is broad and low-contrast at their edges (contrast 0.017).
Mixed prostate tissue has several virtual-DAPI peaks near outlined nuclei, but broad peaks and unmatched bright structures yield AUC 0.698 and contrast 0.029.

scope: Contact-sheet review of positions 85-90 at calibrated 0.25 µm/model pixel; no QC threshold change, marker-validity claim or test-label-guided selection.
